# Chapter 3: Building a Drone **WRONGLY** in GZ sim, please dont follow this for the files

## **1\. Use STL in URDF/Xacro**

Gazebo supports **STL meshes** for both visualization and collision. Here’s how to integrate it into a URDF/Xacro file.

### **URDF/Xacro Example Using an STL Mesh**

Make a ros2 workspace:

Step 1: create workspace  
mkdir \-p \~/drone\_model/src  
cd \~/drone\_model/  
mkdir \~p src

Step 2: Add meshes to the folder

drone\_description/  
├── CMakeLists.txt  
├── package.xml  
├── urdf/  
│   ├── drone.urdf.xacro  
│   ├── rotor.xacro  
│   ├── drone.urdf  
│   ├── drone.sdf  
│   └── drone.world  
├── meshes/  
│   ├── base\_link.STL  
│   ├── rotor1.STL  
│   ├── rotor2.STL  
│   ├── rotor3.STL  
│   └── rotor4.STL  
└   └── rotor5.STL

Step 3: Make CMakeList.txt and package.xml

CMakeList.txt:

cmake\_minimum\_required(VERSION 3.8)  
project(drone\_description)

find\_package(ament\_cmake REQUIRED)  
find\_package(xacro REQUIRED)

install(DIRECTORY urdf meshes  
  DESTINATION share/${PROJECT\_NAME}/  
)

ament\_package()

Package.xml  
\<buildtool\_depend\>ament\_cmake\</buildtool\_depend\>  
\<exec\_depend\>xacro\</exec\_depend\>

### Colcon Build

cd \~/drone\_model  
colcon build \--packages-select drone\_description  
source install/setup.bash

### Xacro Command

ros2 run xacro xacro \~/drone\_model/src/drone\_description/urdf/drone.urdf.xacro \> \~/drone\_model/src/drone\_description/urdf/drone.urdf

drone.world file

Note: **JUST TO BE SURE, EVERY CHANGE MADE REBUILD COLCON. (Minor changes doesn’t need to be rebuilt)**

cd \~/drone\_model  
colcon build \--packages-select drone\_description  
source install/setup.bash

**Rerun Xacro**  
**ros2 run xacro xacro \~/drone\_model/src/drone\_description/urdf/drone.urdf.xacro \> \~/drone\_model/src/drone\_description/urdf/drone.urdf**  
**gz sdf \-p \~/drone\_model/src/drone\_description/urdf/drone.urdf \> \~/drone\_model/src/drone\_description/urdf/drone.sdf**  
**gz sim \~/drone\_model/src/drone\_description/urdf/drone.world**

Sometimes, the meshes doesn’t appear on the drone\_description.  
Recheck the meshes folder for the meshes.

If the models doesnt appear on gazebo:  
cd \~/.gazebo/models  
git clone https://github.com/osrf/gazebo\_models.git .

Step ?: Launch the world in Gazebo

gz sim \~/drone\_model/src/drone\_description/urdf/test.world

![][image3]  
Adjust the drone accordingly. It is recommended to change the visual of the drone, then the collision of the drone.

Visually, the drone is done. But we still need to make the drone work. Such as the propellers flying.

The drone needs to be packaged to be able to work in any environment without worrying about the path of the meshes of the drone.
